Environment · India

Rainfall Forecast for West Bengal and Northern States

A low-pressure system persists over Gangetic West Bengal, with forecasts predicting more rain for Kolkata and southern Bengal. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has also forecast heavy rainfall across several northern states. The low-pressure system is moving inland.
